fact: A DCDT presentation to Parliament's communications committee, dated 24 February 2026, states that the National Data and Cloud Policy provides that government data carrying content on national security and the sovereignty of the Republic shall be stored only in digital infrastructure located within South Africa's borders.

fact: The DCDT states SITA, the State IT Agency, operates the Centurion data centre (primary of two national facilities) hosting mission-critical systems and sensitive government data; both are National Key Points.

A 2025 book chapter reports that the Draft National Policy on Data and Cloud, commented on in 2021, required a copy of data to be kept within South African borders as well as copies for law enforcement, while allowing citizen data to be held abroad; no date for the draft itself is given, so 2021 is the date of the cited submission.
